It's natural to feel blue sometimes, but the truth is that most things and situations have a tendency to improve over time. Give yourself permission to feel your emotions, but also trust that there's light at the end of the tunnel. Remember that setbacks are just temporary, and that the future holds endless possibilities for growth and happiness. Don't let the darkness of the present moment cloud your vision of what's to come. Keep your chin up and believe that better days are ahead.
